## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Santa Cruz de Tenerife, Spain. It starts at Calle San Francisco, 3.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Some buildings are alive with history – you can sense it the moment you step inside, and this certainly rings true for Tenerife's La Casa de los Balcones.
>
> Take an self-guided tour of this 17th-century manor and see the lifestyles enjoyed by its past residents, which were well-to-do families and military figures. See family heirlooms and antiquities, and soak up the tranquil atmosphere of its inner courtyard with views of intricate wooden balconies that evoke the nostalgia of yesteryear.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €8.10. It was rated 4.3 out of 5 from 17 ratings and 11 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
